integrity: All mathematical claims are supplied with an internal proof and a standalone finite verifier. Neither finite tests nor this review constitute independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact multiplicity and structure for labelled products C_m square K_n only, m>=3 and n>=6; no formula for smaller n or all cover sizes. Historical priority not independently certified, and a relevant 2022 product-cover article was available in abstract only.
title: Minimum three-path covers of cyclic clique products: an exact Kneser-spectrum enumerator
